messages:
Maya Ortiz: Noticing more quickstart drift: Node and Python READMEs show different env var names (REDWOOD_KEY vs REDWOOD_API_KEY) and some snippets still have manual retry wrappers. New signups are hitting 401s and duplicate POSTs.

Lucas Chen: I hit that during a demo yesterday. Also the Python quickstart imports the async lib but shows a sync snippet. Super confusing for people trying to run the samples.

Nina Patel: I repro'd locally. Plan: standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY everywhere, remove manual retry wrappers (SDK handles retries by default), and add tiny sync+async variants for Python and Node so parity is obvious.

Maya Ortiz: Sounds good. Can you also update the curl examples to use `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY` and add a short note about token scoping (generation vs embeddings)? That explains most 403 reports.

Nina Patel: Draft snippets to land in the PR:
Python sync:
```python
import os
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.generate('Write a haiku about compilers')
print(resp.text)
```
Python async note: "For async usage import AsyncRedwoodClient and await calls.
Node sync:
```js
const { RedwoodClient } = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const out = await client.generate('Summarize this text');
console.log(out.text);
```
Node ESM/TS note: show named import and constructor options.
Remove manual retry blocks and add doc note: "SDKs apply exponential backoff for transient errors by default. Pass `retries: 0` to disable."

Lucas Chen: LGTM. Leave a tiny nit about wording for the retry opt-out. Also include a short troubleshooting section: "If you see 401, check env var name; if 403, check token scopes."

Maya Ortiz: Approved after nit. Nina, can you sweep Go/Rust/Java quickstarts next sprint? Thanks.

Nina Patel: Pushed PR: https://git.redwood/docs/pull/3450 with env var parity, sync+async snippets, curl header fix, retry note, and token-scope callout. Requesting @maya & @lucas review.

docs-bot: docs-bot: Added label `DX` and requested reviewers: @maya, @lucas.

Lucas Chen: Reviewed and approved.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: docs site updated: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart version 2026-03-24T11:42Z :rocket:

Nina Patel: Closing thread. Will run a grep across all quickstarts for env var and retry wrappers next week. Thanks!
